verdict.rationale: Hyperbrowser documents Profiles that save and reuse browser state across multiple sessions, which directly covers persisting a login so agents skip it on later runs. That state includes cookies, local storage, session storage and cache. Sessions are cloud browser instances that agents and Playwright/Puppeteer connect to, so the profile can be attached to agent runs. Missing for 10: detail on the profile lifecycle API (creating, persisting, attaching to agent tasks), explicit documentation of the logged-in reuse workflow, and independent or hands-on corroboration that saved logins hold across runs.
